nodes.statement: The bounded client flow starts a put, completes it, and later removes the same object.
The flow uses a mounted segment, valid key and owning client, plus a distinct non-owner client for rejection checks.
The lifecycle enters MasterService::PutStart for the object key and owner.
PutStart reserves tenant quota, allocates replicas, and inserts object metadata.
PutStart acquires replica storage and a metadata record for the new object.
The inserted metadata records the initiating client and tenant as owners of the pending put.
The newly inserted replica metadata is published in PROCESSING state.
GetReplicaList and Remove reject the PROCESSING object as not ready.
The service returns REPLICA_IS_NOT_READY for premature access and ILLEGAL_CLIENT for a non-owner PutEnd.
PutEnd from the recorded owner changes the matching replica from PROCESSING to COMPLETE.
The non-HA Remove path erases replica metadata and releases tracked storage and tenant quota accounting.
After removal, GetReplicaList observes OBJECT_NOT_FOUND for the key.
The PutStartEndFlow and RemoveObject tests cover readiness, owner completion, removal, and final absence.

edges.statement: The client lifecycle is exercised with a mounted segment, valid ownership, and a distinct non-owner identity.
Those valid inputs permit the owner request to enter PutStart.
PutStart delegates to quota reservation, replica allocation, and metadata insertion.
The allocation chain creates replica storage and its object metadata record.
The created metadata binds the pending object to its initiating client and tenant.
The owner-scoped metadata records the new replica in PROCESSING state.
PROCESSING state makes both GetReplicaList and Remove return not-ready errors.
Premature operations propagate not-ready, while completion by a different client propagates ILLEGAL_CLIENT.
Rejected operations preserve owner metadata, allowing the recorded owner to complete the pending put.
Once COMPLETE, the object can be removed and its tracked resources released.
Erasing metadata and quota state makes the key absent to later reads.
The lifecycle tests assert both pre-completion unreadiness and post-removal absence.

disconfirming_checks.statement: Before owner PutEnd, both GetReplicaList and Remove must reject the PROCESSING replica.
Owner PutEnd must make the COMPLETE replica readable before Remove erases it.
